name: Nijou Hanon
source: The eldest of the Nijou Sisters and a friend of Niki Ookuma. Hanon was one of Makoto's friends of in Middle High School before her fallout with Otome which resulted in her transfer to Watajo. She is also known to engage in compensate dating with many people.
